plain_english_policy: Redirecting government welfare funds from public entities to private (faith-based/community-based) organizations for delivery.

effects.rationale: The option explicitly directs welfare funding away from public entities toward private organizations.

While not a direct restriction on eligibility or benefits, redirecting funds to private actors may reduce the scope of government-administered welfare programs (e.g., fewer public caseworkers, centralized services).

Faith-based/community organizations may serve populations with lower administrative costs but could disproportionately benefit middle/upper-income areas or exclude certain groups (e.g., non-religious families).
If childcare is part of welfare funding, redirecting it to private actors could reduce public oversight of quality/accessibility (e.g., fewer subsidies or employer mandates).

evidence_quote: "Redirect welfare funding to faith-based and community-based private organizations"
